issue: Built-in NovelAI model presets clutter generation style selectors even though they are intended as templates in the style editor

before.reproduction: Connect the NovelAI backend and open the style selector in the Generation workspace.
before.expected: Built-in NAI V4, V4.5, and V5 Curated/Full templates appear only on the NovelAI style editing page; user-created and duplicated NAI styles remain selectable for generation.
before.actual: The generation selector includes all six built-in NAI templates alongside user styles.

adjacent_working_case: Built-in non-NAI styles retain their existing selector behavior, user-created NAI styles remain selectable, and the style editor continues to list built-in NAI templates.
hypothesis: The generation selector and document initialization both consume Styles.filtered(), which intentionally includes built-in templates for the editor; a separate selectable view can hide only built-in NAI templates without deleting or altering them.
disproof: The hypothesis is false if a built-in NAI template remains in Styles.selectable(), a user NAI style disappears, a built-in local style changes behavior, or the complete editor list no longer contains the NAI template.
